title: Entire Top Floor of Suites of the Vinyl Sleeps 16
description:
*This is a buyout of 4 separate units offering a total of 4 bedrooms and a max occupancy of 16*

Get ready to turn up the volume on your next getaway! Our fabulous collection of four apartments occupies the entire top floor of The Vinyl, a lively hotel nestled right on the iconic Music Row. Whether you're a country music aficionado or just here to soak up the vibrant Nashville scene, our space is the perfect home base for your adventures!

Guest access
We offer keyless entry locking. You will receive an e-mail with the details of your stay. In that email, you will be given a four-digit code for entry.
